articles.title: UPSC Quiz – 2025 : IASbaba’s Daily Current Affairs Quiz 12th December 2025
articles.summary: This platform provides daily current affairs questions crucial for UPSC Prelims, meticulously compiled from key sources like The Hindu, Indian Express, and PIB. Aspirants preparing for the civil services exam can utilize these resources, including previous daily quizzes from the archives, to enhance their knowledge and preparation for national-level assessments.

articles.title: India’s rise to a top-5 economy: The reforms and forces behind 15 years of change
articles.summary: India has notably ascended from the world's ninth-largest economy to the fifth-largest by 2024 within just 15 years, according to World Bank GDP data. This significant economic growth highlights India's strengthening global position and robust national development, reflecting its increasing influence and capabilities on the international stage, crucial for aspirants understanding national progress.
